xquery.xq-expression:
declare variable $employees as node() external; declare variable $dept as xs:string external;
<department_report> <department_name>{$dept}</department_name> <employees> { for $emp in $employees//employee[department = $dept] return <employee> <name>{$emp/name}</name> <age>{$emp/age}</age> <salary>{$emp/salary}</salary> <performance>{$emp/performance}</performance> </employee> } </employees> </department_report>
